summary: Climb Bio, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events to announce initial Phase 1b clinical data for budoprutug in primary ITP. The filing reports safety and efficacy results from 15 patients across two dose cohorts, with no serious adverse events and durable platelet responses in the 250 mg cohort. No transaction or special-situation event is disclosed. The filing is a routine corporate update on clinical trial progress, not a special situation. The registrant is the issuer reporting operational developments.
